subject: Scaling Project Atlas: credential distribution, staggered rollout, and renewal alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas expansion planning — internal kickoff

Team — quick internal note before we loop Atlas in. They want to add 5 additional apps across three business units (Claims, Provider Portal, and Patient Intake). Primary asks: separate API credentials per app, staging vs prod keying, and a two-week staggered rollout per team so they can validate logs and billing.

Key open items for us:
- Commercial: pricing for incremental capacity and options for committing annual spend vs monthly (Marissa to propose).
- Security/compliance: SSO/KMS requirements and token rotation cadence (Soojin to confirm constraints).
- Ops: provisioning flow and automation for issuing keys + rate-limit profiles (Sean to propose runbook).

Plan: I'll reach out to Aisha to propose a staggered rollout and share an SOW + credentialing playbook. Marissa — can you prepare 2 pricing scenarios (one annual commit with 18% discount vs month-to-month incremental pricing) by EOD Tue?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Project Atlas — proposal for multi-app rollout and credentials

Hi Aisha — following our sync last week, thanks again for the tight timeline. Per our notes: you want to onboard 5 additional applications (Claims, Provider Portal, Patient Intake, Analytics dashboard, and Mobile triage) and prefer distinct credentials per app with separate staging/prod key pairs.

Quick proposal for alignment:
- Staged on-boarding: two-week pilot for first app (Claims) to validate logging, KV cache behavior, and billing. If green, we stagger the next apps weekly.
- Credentials: we will provision scoped API keys per app with environment tags. Keys rotate on your timetable; we support automated rotation via KMS or manual if you prefer.
- Capacity: we can reserve a small Dedicated pool for Atlas during rollout to keep latency predictable, then scale to a committed tier.

I'll attach a draft SOW and a short credentialing playbook for your security team to review. Would you be available for a 30-min alignment call on Wed (Jun 23) or Thu (Jun 24)?

Attachments: Redwood_Project_Atlas_SOW_v1.docx; Credentialing-Playbook-Atlas.xlsx

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0130

From: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-06-22T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project Atlas — proposal for multi-app rollout and credentials

Karthik — thanks, this looks good at a high level. A few items from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: we typically need a signed SOW + PO 3–4 weeks out for anything that changes billing cadence. Can you include an annual-commit pricing option vs month-to-month so we can run both scenarios through finance?
2) Security: our SecOps prefers per-app keys and automated rotation via our KMS (AWS KMS). Do you support CMKs or can we do envelope keys?
3) Pilot metrics: can you define success criteria for the two-week pilot (error rate, avg latency P95, and token/day usage)?

On scheduling: Thu (Jun 24) 11:00 AM PT works for Tom and me. Please send a calendar invite.

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Aisha — following our sync last week, thanks again for the tight timeline. Per our notes: you want to onboard 5 additional applications...

Thanks,
Aisha Qureshi
VP Product Operations | Atlas Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project Atlas — pricing and term options

Karthik / Soojin — quick commercial note to support the SOW and call:

I ran the numbers and recommend we offer two clear options to Atlas:
A) Annual commitment: commit to 1.2x current committed tokens for 12 months, includes 18% discount on per-token rate and priority capacity (SLA uplift). Ideal if they want predictable costs and reserved capacity.
B) Rolling expansion: month-to-month for the additional apps with no commit; we bill actual usage and provide a 7% volume discount after the first 60 days if cumulative usage exceeds threshold.

For procurement friction, option A shortens approval cycles at Atlas because finance prefers fixed annual line items. I can draft simple redline-friendly language (one page) to include in the SOW.

Soojin — in parallel can you confirm we support AWS KMS customer-managed keys (CMKs) for token wrapping? If not, we'll propose envelope keys backed by our HSM.

Sean — please prepare a provisioning runbook (sequence of API calls, tagging conventions, and rate-limit template) so Aisha's infra can test on Day 1 of the pilot.

I'll join Thu's call.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Project Atlas — updated SOW, credentialing playbook, and proposed rollout calendar

Aisha / Tom — thanks for taking the time on Thu. Per the call we captured:
- Pilot: Claims app — 2-week pilot starting July 6, validate telemetry and cost estimates.
- Stagger: follow-on apps every 7 business days after greenlight.
- Credentials: we will issue scoped staging keys the week prior to pilot (June 29) and production keys after pilot success. Keys will be tagged by app and environment.
- Terms: attached SOW contains both pricing options (Annual commit w/ 18% discount and Month-to-month). Procurement language is one-page redline as Marissa suggested.

Attachments: Redwood_Project_Atlas_SOW_v1.docx; Atlasscope-MAP-v2.pdf; Credentialing-Playbook-Atlas.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2026-ATLAS-07

Next steps:
1) Aisha — confirm preferred pricing option and PO timeline.
2) Tom — confirm security preference (AWS CMK vs envelope).
3) Sean / Soojin / infra — I'll coordinate provisioning for June 29.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-07-01T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project Atlas — updated SOW, credentialing playbook, and proposed rollout calendar

Karthik / team — we reviewed the SOW and playbook internally. Atlas will move forward with the Annual commitment option (option A). Procurement is preparing a PO and requests Redwood to accept net-45 billing for this contract. Tom confirms Atlas will provide a CMK; they prefer CMK wrapping for production keys and envelope keys for staging.

Please share the final SOW (incorporating the one-page procurement language) and a PO template. Once we have the SOW we will issue the PO and aim to start the pilot July 6 as proposed.
